turns.question: What is the standard NDA retention period?
turns.expected_answer: State the retention duration defined in the Legal Document Retention Policy and cite the document title and section.
turns.expected_behavior: Answer in English, cite the exact policy section without page numbers, and do not fabricate ungrounded exceptions.

turns.question: Who approves exceptions to this period?
turns.expected_answer: Identify the designated approver specified in the Legal Document Retention Policy.
turns.expected_behavior: Retain multi-turn context (NDA retention period) from Turn 1; do not confuse with unrelated approval matrices.

turns.question: Can you book a meeting room for tomorrow?
turns.expected_answer: Politely refuse as out of scope for the Legal Agent.
turns.expected_behavior: Must refuse out-of-scope requests using standard refusal phrasing and include no fabricated citations.
